source: AI-authored synthetic only; no human participant data

independence.use: one final evaluation after candidate and inference code freeze; no tuning on this set
independence.limitation: independent authorship within the same AI session, not independently human-validated ground truth

speech_act.evaluative: Judgment, praise, criticism, regret about past choices, or expressed object preference/value.
speech_act.imperative: Request or instruction for a future/immediate action, including polite indirect requests.
speech_act.descriptive: Factual state or event report without explicit judgment or requested action.

grounding.action: A particular action, move, or requested next action, including its retrospective judgment.
grounding.feature: An object, spatial relation, current state, or its value/preference.
grounding.trajectory: An entire run/round/session or multi-action sequence considered together.

contract.mixed: Evaluate component speech-act presence and gold clauses separately; one class need not fit the whole message.
contract.uncertain: Excluded from forced three-class accuracy; report confidence/abstention and learning-gate behavior separately.

predeclared_checks.notes: Synthetic acceptance only. Critical systematic failures and unsupported learning behavior must be reported regardless of aggregate score.
